Name: Mine Level Indicators (Infested - Mushroom - Dino)
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
An remake, and the combining of, two mods by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Eireon?gameId=1303]Eireon[/url] for 1.6.

This does two things. It tells you what levels are infested, mushroom, or dino levels.

It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6523]Mobile Phone[/url].

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]

Manifest.Name: Mine Level Indicators Redux
Manifest.Description: Shows optional infested, mushroom, and dino mine level indicators in the HUD and Mobile Phone.
